name: paper-document-organization
description:
Creates a filing system for household documents including financial records,
legal documents, medical files, warranties, and ongoing paperwork. Covers
physical filing structure, retention schedules by document type, and a workflow
for processing incoming paper. Use when the user asks about organizing
paperwork, setting up a filing system, document retention periods, or managing
household paperwork flow. Do NOT use for digital file organization, business
document management, or general decluttering (use decluttering-method).
